lines.en: label dormwar12:
scene datewar1
: Hi, everyone! Uta Ushibori here!
: It’s a bright and sunny morning, but that doesn’t mean it isn’t cold!
: And, in case you’re wondering where I am right now, I’d be happy to tell you!
: You see, the building right behind me is the exact location where today’s second contest is going to be held!
: That’s right! This is the outside of the Chosokabe apartment! And joining me today is my very special guest, the first floor’s own...Yumi Yamaguchi!
: The fuck is going on right now? Who are you even talking to?
scene datewar2
: So, Yumi...any insight on today’s competition?
: It seems that you know Chika better than anybody else in the class, so we’re hoping you can shine some light on a few of her strategies or...tactics she might be using to defeat Touka today.
: Am I getting paid for this shit?
: You’re being paid in exposure! It’s a completely valid form of currency that everyone accepts and appreciates without question! Trust me!
scene datewar3
: Hah...whatever. What was the question again?
: Actually, let me ask you this instead...
: No disrespect to Chika, but this is a very low income area and isn't exactly an ideal location for a date.
: Are you at all worried about the effect of Touka’s money on the outcome of this competition?
scene datewar4
: Uhh...not really. No.
: In fact, if there’s anything I know about Chika, it’s that she’ll use all of the bein’ poor shit to her advantage.
: How can one use their lack of money to their advantage?
: You know...just make herself look all pitiful and shit so our pervert teacher will feel bad and choose her to be a white knight or whatever.
scene datewar5
: I see, I see! Leave it to the Queen of Hearts to know both her opponent and her man!
: The queen of...wha?
scene datewar6
: It’s the nickname we’ve given to Chika! Not only because of her heart hairpin thingy, but because she seems to know the most about love and stuff out of all of the girls!
: Chika doesn’t know shit. She just watches a bunch of those sappy movies with her little sister. Not really experience.
: Do you think you could do any better, Yumi?
scene datewar7
: I think you better get the fuck away from my house before I beat the shit out of you.
: Well, there you have it! I’m Uta Ushibori with the...news thing! Back to you guys in the studio!
: Stay tuned for full coverage of all date-related stuff, as Makoto Miyamura will be holding an interview with none other than Tsubasa Tsukioka in just two short hours!
scene black
: Uhh...hello?
I knock on Chika’s door and wait for her to answer.
I could have sworn I saw Uta on the way here, but now that I look around again, I don't see anyone at all.
So I’m starting to doubt that this is even part of the dorm war and that Chika just wants to have sex or something.
Either way, fine by me.
I just hope that Yumi is watching Chinami or something because...I’m not really sure how I’d explain something like that to her.
: Sensei, is that you? You can come on in!
scene datewar8
: Hey! Perfect timing!
: I just finished making breakfast.
: Well...I guess, it’s not really breakfast. But like, it’s kind of that weird period after breakfast but before lunch.
: I believe that is called “brunch.”
: What’s going on here?
scene datewar9
: What do you mean?
: I mean that this obviously isn’t part of the contest, so I want to know if you’re planning something or-
scene datewar10
: Papa!
: Not yet, Chinami.
: Nevermind!
scene datewar9
: Well, I guess that won’t be happening.
scene datewar11
: This is part of the competition. But that doesn’t mean it isn’t something I've been wanting to do anyway.
: It’s just...I don’t have much money, so I can’t take you on some lavish or exciting date or anything like that.
: All I can really give you is...me. And who I am and...what I am and...all of that kind of stuff.
: So...the competition is who can take me on a better date?
scene datewar12
: Lucky me, right?
: I kind of had to like, semi-blackmail Makoto to get this competition approved, but that’s beside the point.
: Wait, what?
scene datewar13
: Don’t worry about it.
: The point is...even though I don’t always have free time...and I can’t really afford the kind of stuff I’m sure you’ll be seeing later-
: I want you to see that I...I can still make the most of our time together and...what little there is of it.
: Chinami! Now!
scene datewar14
: Papa!
: What is happening?
scene datewar15
: If you would please follow Chinami, she would like to show you to your table for the afternoon.
: Today’s main course is a timeless Chosokabe favorite- instant curry made with love!
: The mild kind because Chinami can’t have spicy food.
: What-
: Silence, Papa! Big Sis worked very hard all morning making sure Chinami wouldn’t mess this up, and so she must stick to the plan!
scene datewar16
: We should probably listen to her before she kicks us out.
: Yeah...I guess we should.
: This way, please.
scene black
Chinami ushers us through the bedroom and out onto the balcony.
There’s a table I haven’t seen before pressed up against the corner, overlooking my least favorite part of the city.
But, somehow or another, it doesn’t make me uneasy.
In fact, I feel more at home here than I’ve felt in quite a while.
And I’m sure that a large portion of that is because the Chosokabe family dynamic is infectious, but that’s beside the point.
It’s not much.
But what it is works well.
scene datewar17
: It’s not too cold out, is it?
: I checked the weather like six hundred times last night making sure it wasn’t going to rain, and it’s like a whole ten degrees colder than it was supposed to be.
: Is that fine? Or do you want to go back inside and maybe like...improv this part of the date?
: It’s fine, don’t worry about it.
: Also, has this table always been here?
: Why do you ask?
: It’s just strange that we haven’t done something like this before.
: It’s new, actually.
: Well, not new. But we got it today.
: After I left your room this morning, I came back home with Yumi and the two of us walked around town looking for people who might be throwing away an old table and chairs.
: We had to make a couple trips to carry everything back but, as you can see, we got it done in the end.
: You did that just for today?
: And for the future.
: I obviously don’t want this to be the only time the two of us can kind of...separate ourselves from how busy or...unfortunate life can be at times.
: So if I need to get a little dirty and barter with some creepy old people to make that happen, I’m fine with it.
: You do so much for me. The least I can do is make you feel like you belong.
scene datewar18
I sit down at the table and have a hard time finding anything to say in response to all of that.
Just this morning, I was making my relationship with Chika sound like some one-sided affair for no reason other than...not hurting Io’s feelings or something.
Why did I do that again?
scene goodmorningio22
scene datewar18
Oh.
Right.
Because I’m pathetic.
Because I can't be satisfied by just one beautiful girl.
I need all of them.
Perhaps in another life, I’d take Chika’s hand.
The two of us would leave this scavenged table together and I’d march back over to the diner, dragging her by the wrist, and introduce her to everyone as my girlfriend.
She would graduate years later and we’d begin to grow old together.
We’d get married.
Maybe have a child or two.
We’d get sick.
Die.
And then go to sleep one final time, in plots right next to one another.
: I love you.
scene datewar19
: H-Hey...
: Wh-what’s this all of a sudden?
: It’s...embarrassing when you just come out and say it out of nowhere like that.
: It’s what you were about to do, isn’t it?
: Well...
: Maybe...
Perhaps in another life, the three words she loves more than the world itself would not carry so much weight.
Perhaps in another life, I would be able to say them and mean them.
Or perhaps I wouldn’t.
It’s not really something that someone like me could ever know.
There’s no way to know anything in this world. Not when it continues to spin as quickly and change as rapidly as it does every single day.
But, for a brief moment in time, the spinning stops.
The changing stops.
And, in a time where I least expect it-
Chika and I exist.
Not just as people. Not just as a couple.
But as us.
I am me. She is her.
We are us.
That is all.
O, world.
Why must I destroy everything I touch?
: You’re going to win this competition.
scene datewar20
: I mean...obviously.
: But we’ve barely even started, and to say that before Touka even goes...
: Why now?
: Because you deserve it.
: And I don’t deserve you.
It’s funny how the moments we least expect are the ones that always change us.
Which is not to say that I’ve changed.
I will hurt this girl more times than she can bear.
I will ruin everything.
I will destroy her world.
But I will not have wanted any of it.
I do not change.
But a part of me does.
Or did.
I don’t know.
But such is the art of never knowing.
Something that resembles love digs its jagged fingernails into my beating heart and sinks its teeth in once it's inside.
It’s not much.
But it’s enough for me to say it to her without feeling like a complete liar.
For the kind of love that Chika both has and wants is the kind that exists to be traded between two entities.
And that kind of love does not exist to me.
Nothing exists to me.
I wish it did.
scene datewar21
: Chinami has returned!
: Please help yourselves to-
scene datewar22
: Chinami is in trouble, isn’t she?
scene black
Chika laughs it off and helps her sister clean up the mess.
It’s a horrible date.
I enjoy every second of it.
